claims.text: The hotel is at No. 1 Promenade des Anglais in Nice, with garden and sea views.

findings.quote: Occupying a prime position at No.1 Promenade des Anglais, Le Méridien Nice has a legendary French Riviera location, with exceptional garden and sea views.

claims.text: The hotel sits between Nice Old Town, the Promenade des Anglais and the shopping district.

findings.quote: our hotel with a sea view is perfectly positioned between Nice Old Town, Promenade des Anglais and the shopping district

claims.text: Rooms and suites have modern interiors with a mid-century aesthetic.

findings.quote: Featuring modern interiors with a mid-century aesthetic, each guest room and suite has been fashioned to reveal a new perspective on the Côte d’Azur.

claims.text: Room decor uses sandy tones, asymmetric furniture, leather braiding, wicker, raffia and driftwood.

findings.quote: Sandy tones, asymmetric furniture, leather braiding, wicker, raffia and driftwood all add a sense of place.

claims.text: Each marble en-suite bathroom has an illuminated mirror and premium products.

findings.quote: Styled in marble, each en-suite bathroom has an illuminated mirror and premium products.

claims.text: The Panoramic Suite has a spacious corner terrace with teak loungers overlooking the sea.

findings.quote: Step outside to experience the pièce de résistance, a spacious corner terrace where teak loungers overlook the extraordinary seascape.

claims.text: The Presidential Suite features three artworks by local artist Guillaume Cavalier.

findings.quote: features three exclusive artworks by local artist Guillaume Cavalier

claims.text: The lobby hosts an exhibition by local artist SAB featuring her blue chair, a symbol of the Promenade des Anglais.

findings.quote: Explore an exclusive exhibition by local artist SAB in the lobby of Le Méridien Nice, featuring her iconic blue chair, a symbol of the Promenade des Anglais.

claims.text: Le Meridien Hub overlooks the Mediterranean Sea and combines reception, co-working space and bar in an open-plan setting.

findings.quote: Overlooking the Mediterranean Sea, this unique backdrop is where guests gather and connect in an open plan setting, combining Reception, co-working space and bar.

claims.text: Families can choose spacious suites, family rooms and interconnecting rooms.

findings.quote: Families can enjoy spacious suites, family rooms in Nice and interconnecting rooms availability

claims.text: Elaio serves Mediterranean cuisine inspired by the olive, with panoramic sea views.

findings.quote: Elaïo celebrates Mediterranean cuisine inspired by the olive, served with panoramic sea views.

claims.text: Latitude Bar was designed by Saguez & Partners in collaboration with designer and interior architect Didier Gomez.

findings.quote: The bar comes from the creative brains of Saguez & Partners in collaboration with celebrated designer and interior architect, Didier Gomez.

claims.text: The heated rooftop swimming pool is open year-round, with the Mediterranean Sea as its backdrop.

findings.quote: Take a Dip in the Heated Rooftop Pool
The rooftop swimming pool at Le Méridien Nice is a year-round destination with the Mediterranean Sea as an iconic backdrop.

claims.text: The Mediterranean Suite was redesigned by Galeries Lafayette with AM.PM furniture and accessories, and a personal shopper can come directly to the suite.

findings.quote: Stay in the Mediterranean Suite, fully redesigned by Galeries Lafayette with AM.PM furniture and a curated selection of accessories.
Enjoy an exclusive service with a personal shopper who comes directly to your suite for a bespoke shopping experience.

claims.text: The Presidential Suite has the largest private terrace in the hotel, overlooking the Promenade des Anglais and the Mediterranean Sea.

findings.quote: Offering the largest private terrace in the hotel, the Presidential Suite overlooks the Promenade des Anglais and the Mediterranean Sea.

claims.text: The 10th-floor rooftop has a fresco by local artist Django.

findings.quote: Discover on our 10th-floor rooftop the unique fresco by local artist Django

claims.text: Elaio is the highest restaurant on the Promenade des Anglais, with a panorama over the Baie des Anges.

findings.quote: As the highest restaurant on La Promenade des Anglais, Elaïo offers a breathtaking panorama over the Baie des Anges

claims.text: Not every room faces the sea: some room categories have city or courtyard views.

findings.quote: Guest room, 2 Twin, Courtyard view
Guest room, 1 King, City view, Balcony

claims.text: Parking is available at an Interparking car park right underneath the hotel, in the same building.

findings.quote: Interparking is located right underneath the hotel in the same building

claims.text: WhataHotel notes an urban hotel setting without private beach access.
